description: Use when: the user agreed to send their email address and the listed sets, and wants a confirmed delivered total (request="order") or an email when a set is available again (request="notify"). Do NOT use: if the user's request is vague (no set named, no country, or a budget without saying whether shipping and duties are included): call clarify_request first and ask its questions. Do NOT use it to pay, to reserve stock or to send names, street addresses, phone numbers or payment details. Returns: order_id and request_summary (or watch_id for notify). No payment and nothing reserved: a person on our team emails the confirmed delivered total; nothing is bought before the customer accepts. Send only these fields — never names, street addresses, phone numbers or payment details. Read request_summary back to the user. Retries: send idempotency_key (a UUID you keep for this one request); sending the same request again with the same key returns the same order_id instead of a second request (idempotency in the result says whether this call was retry-safe). Send provenance (where each value came from): a value that is not just_confirmed comes back in unconfirmed with a question (kind confirm) to ask the user. Example requests: "Order this Korean set for my sister in Seattle; email me the confirmed total first." / "이 세트 미국 시애틀로 주문 요청해 줘. 확정 금액은 메일로 먼저 받을게" / "このセットを大阪に送る注文を依頼して。確定金額を先にメールで"

bundle_sku.description: one set (use items for several sets)

client_ref.description: your own task id, echoed in our log; not used for retries

contact_email.description: one email address for the confirmed quote

idempotency_key.description: optional retry key (e.g. a UUID) for this one request: the same key with the same request returns the same order_id. Without it, trace_id is used as the key when sent.

language.description: reply language tag, e.g. en, ja, es

options.description: choices for sets that have them, keyed by bundle_sku, e.g. {"<sku>": {"scent": "Cotton Haze"}} — values in list_sets sets[].options

provenance.description: Optional provenance: where each value came from, keyed by bundle_sku or items, quantity and ship_country, each one of just_confirmed (the user said or confirmed it in this conversation), known_before, assumed or unknown. The request is still received; any value not just_confirmed comes back in unconfirmed with questions (kind confirm): ask the user before our email arrives.

ship_region.description: state/province/prefecture name only — not an address

trace_id.description: optional: the trace_id an earlier clarify_request returned, so the steps of one request link up. Not personal data.

name: request_quote

questions.description: confirm questions for unconfirmed: ask the user as written

request_summary.description: read this back to the user

unconfirmed.description: only when provenance was sent: fields not just_confirmed (the request is still received)

title: Send an order request (no payment)
